items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser keeps skin comfortable while the scan shows very low moisture.
A starter-strength retinol serum for the night is a well-known cosmetic choice to help soften the look of lines and improve the look of firmness.
A rich ceramide and glycerin cream supports the look of plumper, more comfortable skin where moisture reads low.
A mineral SPF 50 each morning is needed with retinol and helps protect the look of skin from further visible signs of aging.

response.routine_note: Cleanse morning and night, then apply sunscreen after moisturizer in the morning. Start the retinol 2 nights a week, followed by the cream, and increase slowly as your skin feels comfortable.
